name: ax-narrate
tagline_zh: 写字的人会喜欢：ax-narrate。英文简介见下。
desc_en: Write the agent-generated narration of the current session - the reviewable story of what changed, including what never reaches a PR (user corrections, abandoned attempts, tool failures). Triggers on "narrate this session", "summarize what changed", "write the session story", "narrate what we did", "session narration". Output is .ax/narrations/<session-id>.json for the ax studio narration view. Do
